source_policy: Illustrative excerpt of the canonical registry. Only user-agent product tokens the operator itself publishes in its own crawler documentation are admitted; every entry cites that documentation URL. IP ranges are advisory hints only — a user-agent match is attribution, not proof; the ip_hints_source URL is the live source of truth.
licensed_meaning: licensed_under_soc reflects the operator's DECLARED crawl purpose measured against the Search Only Terms Contract's licence scope (Search Indexing only, socw/2 Clause 4). This is a classification aid, not legal advice.

signatures.notes: Google Search index crawler. Google publishes the authoritative range list as JSON (ip_hints_source).
OpenAI's crawler for content that may be used to train generative models. OpenAI publishes the authoritative egress ranges as JSON (ip_hints_source).

robots.txt control token: Apple documents that Applebot-Extended does not crawl webpages itself — it governs whether Applebot-crawled content may train Apple foundation models. Will not match live traffic; kept for robots audits and declaration tooling.
